attack.label: Major projects, government businesses and cost blowouts
attack.note: Governments attacked over costs and secrecy, from Victoria's Suburban Rail Loop and Tasmania's TT-Line to Brisbane 2032 and South Australia's turbines.

TAS: Failing government businesses: TT-Line, Homes Tasmania, Metro
VIC: Suburban Rail Loop secret tax and costs
SA: North Adelaide Golf Course procurement and transparency
Hydrogen Jobs Plan and unsold turbines
ACT: Major project decisions and weaker procurement oversight

attack.label: Governments resisting or underfunding the Auditor-General
attack.note: Members attacked governments for underfunding the office, withholding information, weakening its independence or waving away its findings.

TAS: Dismissing the Auditor-General's TT-Line insolvency finding
Underfunding the Auditor-General and the six-audit promise
WA: Ministers withholding information and section 82 notices
Auditor General's independence and government transparency
VIC: Integrity agency funding and treatment of Auditor-General
NT: Auditor-General independence ranking and performance audit powers
Integrity and Ethics Commissioner Bill and Auditor-General independence

attack.label: Roads, housing, health and child safety
attack.note: Governments attacked over deteriorating roads, housing maintenance, health delivery and slow child safety reforms, with audit findings as evidence.

VIC: Deteriorating state roads and maintenance funding
WA: Slow progress on child safety reforms
Health delivery: mental health reforms, payments, Geraldton delays
Public housing maintenance and vacant properties
ACT: Minister's record on public housing and school infrastructure
Safer families levy and corrections rostering
NSW: Aboriginal land claims and First Nations services

attack.label: Former governments and oppositions
attack.note: Government members blamed former governments for procurement, privatisation and policy failures, and accused Victoria's opposition of misusing audit reports.

NSW: Former government's privatisation, contracting and pork-barrelling legacy
QLD: Labor's record on ecotourism policy and approvals
Labor's games planning and Gabba cost figures
Labor's youth crime and detention record
Labor's mental health levy and health infrastructure

attack.label: State finances, debt and budget reliability
attack.note: Members used audit findings on debt, deficits, overspending and budget papers to attack governments' financial management.

VIC: State debt, deficits and unreliable budget papers
SA: Rising state debt and capital program risk
NSW: Government administration, spending controls and transparency
ACT: Budget reliability and the territory's finances

attack.label: Direct attacks on the Auditor-General
attack.note: Tasmania's Premier and Treasurer disputed the TT-Line insolvency finding, saying solvency is for directors. Nearly every direct attack on an Auditor-General is this dispute.

TAS: Ministers disputing the Auditor-General on TT-Line solvency

praise.label: Governments acting on audit findings
praise.note: Ministers and government members credited their own side with accepting recommendations, making fixes and delivering services after audits.

VIC: Government's response to critical audit reports
WA: Agencies responding to audit findings with improvements
Mental health recommendations accepted and being delivered
NSW: Government defends programs and reforms against audit concerns

praise.label: The Auditor-General's own work
praise.note: Members thanked Auditors-General and their offices for frank, independent work, including farewells to the ACT's outgoing Auditor-General.

ACT: Outgoing Auditor-General Michael Harris and the Audit Office
VIC: Auditor-General's independence and quality of work
WA: Credit to the Auditor General's own work
NT: Auditor-General's assistance to the Public Accounts Committee

praise.label: Programs and projects said to be on track
praise.note: Ministers cited audit findings or oversight to say programs, hospitals and projects are delivering or on budget.

SA: Major infrastructure project assurance and delivery
New Women's and Children's Hospital on track
North Adelaide Golf Course compliance and budget
TAS: Government defending its record against criticism

praise.label: Support for the office, and oversight as a defence
praise.note: Governments credited themselves with more funding and access for the office, and pointed to its oversight to defend bills and procurement.

WA: Funding and access given to the Auditor General
Government arrangements defended by citing Auditor General oversight

praise.label: Credit claimed for a former government's work
praise.note: Queensland Labor members said work on audit recommendations was largely done before the 2024 election.

QLD: Labor's earlier work on ecotourism recommendations
